Class EDPRowRange

  • Object
    • EDPRowRange
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    EDPRowAddress

    public class EDPRowRange
extends Object
implements Serializable
    Objects of this class carry a row range to access editor fields or rows within an editor. A row range describes a contiguos range of row numbers in form of "start row ... end row".
    Version:
    1
    Author:

      • EDPRowRange

        public EDPRowRange(int from,
                   int to)
        Creates a row range using a from and to row.
        Parameters:
        from - first row number of the range
        to - last row number of the range

      • EDPRowRange

        public EDPRowRange(String fromRowSpec,
                   String toRowSpec)
        Creates a row range using a from and to row specification. Both row specifications must address a single row.
        Parameters:
        fromRowSpec - row specification to address the first row of the range
        toRowSpec - row specification to address the last row of the range
